sources.title: Indiana Election Division, certified 2024 General Election results archive (ENR), office category 1007 JSON with county breakdown (settings: Certified=T)
Indiana Election Division, 2024 General Election results archive

method: pipeline/patches/2024_IN_GOV_monroe.py (via _in_enr.py) takes the Monroe County entry from the certified JSON. Party D is dem, R is rep, and Libertarian, independent and write-in candidates are oth.
validation: Monroe 18105 = official county totals dem 36,675 / rep 19,961 / oth 1,945 (MIT had only dem 10,280 / rep 4,602). Certified statewide: dem 1,183,741 / rep 1,566,081. With this fill, the MIT-based state total is dem 1,238,201 (+4.6%) / rep 1,663,023 (+6.2%). The excess is outside Monroe: MIT counts Hendricks (18063) and St. Joseph (18141) twice, and Marshall (18099) and Warrick (18173) are slightly short.
